proposal.summary: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3 contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) that allows an administrative user to bypass a database restriction on the query setting page and connect to an unintended database.
proposal.cwe_quote: may bypass the database restriction set on the query setting page, and connect to a user unintended database.

AV.quote: Server-side request forgery vulnerability exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.

PR.quote: A user who can access the affected product with an administrative privilege

C.quote: connect to a user unintended database.

I.quote: connect to a user unintended database.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or review a full technical report or proof-of-concept showing the SSRF request, the exact database access obtained, and whether exploitation requires authenticated administrative access; if confirmed, prepare coordinated disclosure and vendor patching guidance.
